commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: The day is clear. The receiving place is not.

commands.speaker: dr_carrier
commands.text: I borrowed it before the rain. I do not want to put it where nobody finds it.

commands.speaker: sister_aveline
commands.text: Nobody will send you back into the rain for an unclear line.

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: Nor will we improve the line by guessing confidently.
The original slip remains beside the book. Mirel writes its page number on a dry scrap.

commands.speaker: sister_aveline
commands.text: There is a dry side room, and a sound table beside this wall. Which can we make ready first?
